title: ReplanResult
description: What a replan Smith writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result replan. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN.

steer.description: Course changes for filed children still open: each is commented on the child and rides in its later briefs, binding.

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.

child.description: The issue number of a filed child in state open (the brief's split.filed).

message.description: What the child must do differently; binding on its later runs.

title.description: The child issue's title, filed as is.

body.description: The child issue's markdown body; the engine reads its sections.

kind.description: Branched on: which flow the child is filed for.

featureMode.description: Ignored: a feature child takes its parent's mode. Omit it.

points.description: The child's story points (bots/story-points.md), at most 13: recorded on the filed child.
